title: Craft Blend 2-Mix Trio #18 (RomanianHorezu+KlimtMosaic / HungarianKalocsa+FilipinoYakan / CubistFragment+VasarelyOpArt)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult German woman in her late 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair cool-toned skin, soft taupe eyeshadow, a glossy nude-pink lip, demure and soft, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in long locs gathered loosely, real living eyes. Long square nails, glittery finish.

Left woman's physique: An enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted in two different patterns covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere. Her upper body, from her collarbones down to her waistline, is painted in Romanian Horezu ceramic (a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs), wide ochre bands following every deep crease, dense spiral floral bands filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Her lower body, from her waistline down to her ankles, is painted in Klimt-inspired organic mosaic (an organic mosaic of small irregular tesserae with gold-leaf borders), wide gold bands following every crease, dense organic curved mosaic filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Rather than a sharp boundary, the two painted patterns blend gradually into each other across a soft irregular zone a few inches wide, motifs from each pattern scattered into the other's territory, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: full side profile, one arm reaching forward.

Left woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto pumps, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Emirati woman in her mid 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, smoky bronze eyes, a soft nude lip, warm golden-tan skin, an elegant composed expression, cool and composed, cool ash-grey hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real living eyes. Long oval nails, glossy finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted in two different patterns covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere. Her LEFT side is painted in Hungarian Kalocsa folk painted motif (a deep black ground with bright red, pink and gold folk-art florals), wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense folk-art floral motifs filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Her RIGHT side is painted in Filipino Yakan painted pattern (a black ground densely patterned with bright geometric diamond bands), wide magenta-and-gold bands following every crease, dense geometric diamond work filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Rather than a sharp boundary, the two painted patterns blend gradually into each other across a soft irregular zone a few inches wide, motifs from each pattern scattered into the other's territory, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: reclining on her side, propped on one elbow.

Center woman's footwear: extreme extreme platform square-toe heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Right woman: a real adult Korean woman in her mid 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair porcelain skin, two round red yeonji blush circles painted on the cheeks and a small round red gonji dot at the centre of the forehead, clearly defined dark brows, softly lined eyes with bright real catchlights, small vivid red lips, a serene, dignified expression, cool and composed, soft pastel-peach hair styled in a mohawk with volume along the centre of the scalp, real living eyes. Long almond nails, chrome finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted in two different patterns covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere. Her LEFT side is painted in Cubist-fragmented pattern (sharp angular asymmetric flat planes seen from several angles at once), wide silver bands following every deep crease, dense angular fragment planes filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Her RIGHT side is painted in Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern (a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion), wide silver bands following every crease, dense optical illusion grid filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Rather than a sharp boundary, the two painted patterns blend gradually into each other across a soft irregular zone a few inches wide, motifs from each pattern scattered into the other's territory, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, face unpainted.

Right woman's pose: both hands framing her own face.

Right woman's footwear: extreme platform high-heel mules, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 8K.
